 Updated: 10:29 PM EST Nov 2, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Ava Marie Meteorologist BALTIMORE — Maryland will luck out with great weather state-wide for election day, before much-needed rain arrives later this week. 
 || Closings/Delays | Weather Advisories | Radar | Forecast | Email Alerts | Send us your pics || 
 Advertisement Milder Tuesday
 After a chilly start to the day, it will quickly turn milder on Tuesday with more sunshine.
 Hearst Owned Temperatures will end up in the low 70s by Tuesday afternoon, which is about 10 degrees above normal for early November.
